_comment: Style archetypes of M5. Replaceable by a bigger list (e.g. clustering output) without code changes: every style needs id, family and description; families need a label. vector_source: text (FashionCLIP text encoder on description) or images (mean of the FashionCLIP embeddings of `examples`, image URLs or data URLs).

styles.label: Casual
styles.description: a relaxed casual everyday outfit, t-shirt, jeans and sneakers

styles.label: Casual chic
styles.description: a casual chic outfit, neat blouse or knit, straight trousers, loafers, polished but relaxed

styles.label: Smart casual
styles.description: a smart casual outfit, chinos, button-down shirt, light blazer and leather shoes

styles.label: Classic
styles.description: a classic elegant office outfit, tailored blazer, trousers, neutral colours

styles.label: Minimalist
styles.description: a minimalist outfit with clean lines, plain monochrome pieces in black, white and grey

styles.label: Bohemian
styles.description: a bohemian outfit, flowing floral maxi dress, fringes, earthy tones, sandals

styles.label: Streetwear
styles.description: a streetwear outfit, oversized hoodie, graphic print, cargo pants and chunky sneakers

styles.label: Sport
styles.description: a sporty athletic outfit, track jacket, leggings or joggers and running shoes

styles.label: Romantic
styles.description: a romantic feminine outfit, soft pastel colours, lace, ruffles and a flowy skirt

styles.label: Vintage
styles.description: a vintage retro outfit, high-waisted pieces, polka dots, seventies patterns

styles.label: Traditional
